posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
I got 2 pushing the limits when I had Pushing the limits in play.

 Also putting 2 light speed Barrage into play with 1 burst card in the trash, that wasn't so hot.

My favorite awesome moment was with Caspit's Playground in play I used Science on Mr. Fixer and he got a tool and style in play when he had none, I think it was Hoist Chain and Grease Monkey.

Mostly she rewards you for knowing the breakdown of different decks, and taking the right gambles at the right time.

She's a Meta Hero, watch the cards people are using and kind of estimate what's left in the deck to get your odds.

She's really fun and can do a lot of good, esp. with heroes like Expat or Naturalist that have a lot of certain keywords.  Oh, and the heroes from Wrath?  Holy [REDACTED] Legacy, I'm speechless!
